information: Please read all the information in the **FAQ** and the **Important Information** tabs before registering. **Spectators may attend for free. There is no need to book!** **PLEASE NOTE**: For this competition, there will be competitor limits for some events: - 4x4 BLD/5x5 BLD: first 20 to register Spaces are available on a first come first served basis. If you are amongst the first 20 to register for these events, you will get a space in them. If you are not within the first people registered, your registration for that event will be removed after the close of registration. However we will be keeping a waiting list for these specific events in the case of dropouts before registration closes. Please only consider registering for these events if you are certain you would like to compete in them.
